messages: Maya: Quick design check — I noticed a few usability/accessibility rough spots in the trace viewer: the legend feels divorced from the timeline, the search box is small and tucked into the header, and the copy/correlation-id affordance is ambiguous. Figma: https://figma.com/file/redwood/trace-legend-proposals :mag: Eduardo: +1 re: legend. On narrow screens it gets pushed under the timeline and users lose context. Maybe a collapsible left rail? :thinking_face: Samir: Left rail is doable but we should be mindful of vertical real-estate for long traces. Also, copying the correlation id currently copies the whole `request:/span` string — we should let users choose "short id" vs "full path". Anne: For keyboard nav we need a clear tab order. If we move the legend to a left rail, make sure it gets `role="navigation"` and `aria-label="trace legend"`. Also, the search input should have `aria-describedby` for the filters. Claire: Microcopy suggestion: instead of a lone copy icon, label it `Copy trace id` visible on hover and expose `Copy trace id` to screen readers permanently via offscreen text. Users confuse the clipboard icon with download/export. Priya: On exports — we should group export CSV/JSON/permalink under a single menu to prevent accidental clicks. Also prefer a confirmation toast that includes the copied id in a selectable format. Security note: be careful with long-term storage of full path ids in export payloads. deploy-bot: Deployed trace-viewer v2 to staging at 2024-04-10T16:04:00Z :rocket: Maya: Good call on the copy options. Proposed small UX: 1) left collapsible legend (default collapsed on < 960px), 2) larger search with smart suggestions and `Ctrl+F` fallback, 3) a kebab menu next to the trace title for export/permalink/copy-id. Sketch attached in Figma. Samir: Implementation notes from runtime: prefix/KV cache traces render progressively, so legend needs to support dynamic state (e.g., disabled traces show dimmed legend entries). We can add a CSS modifier class for that. Also estimating ~2-3 dev days for left-rail + search polish. Anne: Accessibility checklist: keyboard focus, screen reader labels for each action, `aria-expanded` on the legend rail, and a live region for export/copy to announce success. Example snippet: ``` Trace id copied to clipboard ``` Eduardo: Copy toast should include a short link: `Copied trace id · View trace` so follow-up is one click. Also suggest wording: `Trace ID copied` vs `Copied to clipboard` — prefer the former for clarity. Maya: Quick accessibility nit: ensure contrast on the legend color swatches when label text is overlaid. If we use tiny labels, add `aria-hidden` on visuals and expose full text via screen-reader-only spans. Claire: Visual polish: add subtle divider between legend and timeline, and animate collapse/expand to help orientation. Also consider a small search pill showing active filters (e.g., "error: 5") that is keyboard-focusable. Priya: ✅ I'll run a short a11y sweep on the staging build once @samir's changes land. Expect results in 48 hours. Samir: I'll start a branch tomorrow, will ping when ready for review. ETA Fri. Maya: Action items: (1) Claire updates Figma with left-rail mock + search pill, (2) Samir implements branch and adds aria markup, (3) Anne verifies keyboard trap and `aria-live` behavior, (4) Priya runs a11y sweep on staging. I'll thumbs-up the new mocks once done. :thumbsup: Eduardo: Sounds good. One last copy tweak: use sentence case for button labels — `Copy trace id` not `Copy Trace ID`. Small but consistent. Maya: Got it. I'll roll that into the Figma text styles. Thanks all — closing thread after sketches updated.
